title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
subtitle: Practical Programming for Total Beginners
author: Al Sweigart
description: A practical, project-based introduction to Python for people with no programming experience. Covers the language basics, then automating everyday tasks: working with spreadsheets, PDFs, web scraping, email, images, and the file system.
